curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42123-1-1.pdf (one book; the function page is page 144)

functions.does: The 12 tooth gear on top of the roof steers the front wheels: its upright shaft drives a pair of 12 tooth bevel gears under the cockpit, and a long shaft forward to a 12 tooth gear at the front slides the steering rack across, turning both front hubs.
functions.source: book: page 144 (right inset, the roof gear with a turning arrow and a front wheel steering), steps 49-59 (the upright shaft and bevel gears), step 220 (the gear on the roof)
functions.note: The model file leaves out step 220's gear and axle on the roof, so the control here is the upright shaft (p49) it would turn.

functions.does: Rolling the car turns the V8 engine behind the seats: the right rear wheel's axle turns the crankshaft through two 12 tooth bevel gears, and the crankshaft pushes the eight yellow pistons up and down in their two tilted banks.
functions.source: book: page 144 (middle inset, the yellow pistons with an up-and-down arrow), steps 1-35 (engine and crankshaft); which wheel drives it is from the parts (the left rear wheel turns on its own axle)

functions.does: The two doors swing up and forward on hinges at their front corners (dihedral doors).
functions.source: book: page 144 (main picture and left inset, both doors up), steps 199-213 (the doors, with red arrows showing them swing)

functions.does: The front wheels and the left rear wheel roll freely.
